law: row/collection cardinality never determines target-population membership or denominator support
population membership may be time/cut dependent; time alone does not define eligibility
norms require authorized issuers/deciders, but authority does not determine whether a state is permission, prohibition, duty, waiver, fulfillment or breach
an obligation or prohibition is not its enforcement attempt or external effect
provenance can be graph-shaped and ordered while generation/usage/derivation relations retain semantics beyond topology
source/derivation provenance records where something came from; separate authority decides whether that source was authoritative
an observed or simulated value may each be uncertain; epistemic status and uncertainty type are independent questions
causal graphs may be directed/acyclic, but topology/order does not establish causal edge semantics
causal estimates/counterfactuals have epistemic status, while causal identification additionally requires intervention/assignment/assumption semantics
causal estimands are population scoped; population membership alone does not identify a causal effect
random mechanisms generate stochastic executions; uncertainty represents incomplete/probabilistic knowledge and may exist without random execution
reproducible stochastic runs require generator/version/state provenance, but provenance alone does not define the stochastic mechanism
randomized assignment may support causal identification, but causal semantics also cover nonrandomized interventions and assumptions
an observation/measurement result may carry quantity semantics, while targets, prices, notionals, rates and declared amounts can exist without an observation act
unit/currency/ratio basis is semantic interpretation; textual formatting and serialization are representations
quantitative equality requires compatible kind/unit/basis semantics beyond numeric equality
rates and denominated measures may import denominator/population support, but population scope is not the numeric value kind
property, observation, result, instrument/procedure and sampling-feature identities remain distinct
measurement uncertainty may use generic uncertainty carriers but does not collapse calibration/error/traceability into uncertainty
measurement provenance records procedure/instrument/reference history while metrological traceability imposes stronger reference-chain conditions
